tasks.story: Implement secure file storage abstraction with S3-compatible backend and time-boxed signed URLs for document access.
acceptance: FileStorageService abstraction supports local/S3 backends
Signed URLs expire after configurable time (default 15min)
Virus scan webhook integration placeholder exists
Unit tests cover upload, retrieval, URL generation
Audit event logged on document upload and access

tasks.story: Extend DocTask model with file reference, OCR status, and parsed_data JSON field for structured document extraction.
acceptance: DocTask.file_key links to storage service
DocTask.ocr_status field (pending/processing/completed/failed)
DocTask.parsed_data JSON field stores extracted values
Migration applies cleanly on existing data
Serializer exposes new fields with masking for PII

tasks.story: Create OCR callback webhook endpoint to receive parsed document data and update DocTask with extracted values.
acceptance: POST /api/documents/ocr-callback/ endpoint exists
Validates webhook signature/token for security
Updates DocTask.parsed_data and status atomically
Creates audit event for OCR completion
Returns 200 on success, 4xx/5xx on validation errors

tasks.story: Build document portal UI with sectionized task cards, upload progress, file preview, and retry controls.
acceptance: Groups tasks by section (Income, Credit, Assets, etc.)
Upload button with progress indicator per task
Preview common file types (PDF/image) in modal or inline
Retry button visible for failed OCR tasks
Mobile-responsive layout with MUI components

tasks.story: Implement income calculation service supporting W-2 salary/hourly with OT/bonus logic and Schedule C self-employment starter logic.
acceptance: IncomeCalculator class outputs monthly_income for W-2 scenarios
Handles hourly with OT multiplier (1.5x)
Bonus averaging over specified months (12/24/36)
Schedule C profit/loss calculation (2-year average starter)
Unit tests cover 4+ scenarios (salary, hourly+OT, bonus, Sched C)

tasks.story: Add rules engine service to allow toggling income inclusion/exclusion rules (e.g., <10 payments, cosigned accounts).
acceptance: RulesService model stores rule definitions (JSON schema)
API endpoint GET /api/income/rules/ lists available toggles
API endpoint POST /api/income/calculate/ accepts rule overrides
Rules include: exclude_cosigned, min_payment_months threshold
Changes to rules logged in audit events

tasks.story: Build LO Console with Credit and Doc Tasks tabs, including include/exclude toggles and real-time DTI preview.
acceptance: Two tabs render: Credit Review, Document Tasks
Credit tab shows tradelines with include/exclude checkboxes
DTI preview updates on toggle change (debounced API call)
Rule tooltips explain each toggle (MUI Tooltip)
RBAC enforced: only LO/Admin roles access console

tasks.story: Create DTI calculation endpoint that accepts income + selected debts and returns DTI ratio with breakdown.
acceptance: POST /api/underwriting/dti/ endpoint exists
Accepts monthly_income and array of debt IDs to include
Returns frontend_ratio and backend_ratio percentages
Returns breakdown: total_monthly_debt, total_monthly_income
Validates input and returns 400 on missing/invalid data

tasks.story: Ensure document metadata never logs full filename if it contains PII; hash filenames for audit events.
acceptance: FileStorageService generates hash-based keys (SHA256)
AuditEvent.context stores file_hash, not original filename
Original filename stored only in encrypted DocTask.metadata JSON
Unit test verifies no PII leakage in logs/events
docs/COMPLIANCE.md updated with document PII section

tasks.story: Write end-to-end integration test for doc upload, OCR callback, income calc, and LO console DTI preview flow.
acceptance: Test creates DocTask, uploads file, triggers OCR webhook
Test creates W-2 income, calculates monthly_income
Test calls DTI endpoint with selected debts
Test verifies LO console can retrieve DTI preview
Test runs in CI without external OCR service (mocked)
